title: I do not do Sudoku!
text: I have gotten this for several months and twice I have gotten Sudoku puzzle books.  Arg.  I like most other kinds of puzzles.  And I got a Family Guy coloring book.  This is not a show I watch.  So perhaps the coloring books should be more un-themed in regard to TV shows or movies.  It is a Niche market
